# Install Red-DiscordBot

Downloads a Red-DiscordBot build artifact and installs it using uv.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact_name` | ❌ | — | Optional artifact name to download. Default: red-discordbot-build |
